title: P1-02 — Secure foreground interactive v3 VM session
objective: P1-02 foreground session. Successor to #49/#51; depends on P1-01 ticket #53 evidence/supersession and P1-03 ticket #55's timeboxed 2.2.5 compatibility findings before protected TUI integration. Proposed trust-boundary changes require explicit owner approval before implementation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Session runs only from the protected installed launcher, exports exactly one owner-selected bounded workspace, uses a foreground PTY with terminal restoration, disables SSH escape commands with EscapeChar=none, and enforces an owner-approved finite session deadline.
Session uses per-run ephemeral guest/auth state and verified teardown; no credential or guest state persists after successful destruction.
SIGINT and SIGHUP trigger bounded cleanup and nonzero failure when cleanup is uncertain; SIGKILL is treated as possible orphaning, never as successful cleanup.

Provide an owner-only recovery procedure for interrupted sessions that verifies run identity, exact executable/start-time/argv identity and listener state; only identity-bound owned processes may be terminated, never PID-file contents. Ambiguous evidence preserves state and fails closed.

Tests cover PTY input/output/resize/terminal restoration, deadlines, signal cases, sequential cleanup budget, orphan recovery, unrelated-process preservation, no credential persistence, and no broad host access.

needed: Owner approval for foreground lifecycle/recovery trust boundary and finite deadline.
PTY and resize tests; SIGINT/SIGHUP cleanup; SIGKILL orphan recovery with exact-identity fixtures and host canary.
Full protected smoke on final SHA after any launcher/provisioning change.
